Polynomials

Source: R/numpy_polynomial.R
jnp_polynomial.Rd

Ports of jnp.poly, jnp.polyadd, jnp.polysub, jnp.polymul, jnp.polydiv, jnp.polyder, jnp.polyint, jnp.polyval, jnp.polyfit and jnp.roots. Coefficient vectors run from the highest degree to the constant term.

Usage

jnp_roots(p, strip_zeros = TRUE)

jnp_polyfit(x, y, deg, rcond = NULL, full = FALSE, w = NULL, cov = FALSE)

jnp_poly(seq_of_zeros)

jnp_polyval(p, x, unroll = NULL)

jnp_polyadd(a1, a2)

jnp_polysub(a1, a2)

jnp_polyint(p, m = 1L, k = NULL)

jnp_polyder(p, m = 1L)

jnp_polymul(a1, a2, trim_leading_zeros = FALSE)

jnp_polydiv(u, v, trim_leading_zeros = FALSE)

Arguments

strip_zeros

roots: strip leading zeros (needs concrete values); with FALSE the result has one NaN entry per leading zero.

x

Points at which to evaluate (polyval) or sample coordinates (polyfit).

y

Sample values (1-D, or 2-D with one column per data set).

deg

Degree of the fitted polynomial.

rcond

Relative condition number for the least squares solve.

full

Also return the residuals, rank, singular values and rcond.

w

Optional weights of the samples.

cov

Also return the covariance matrix of the coefficients (TRUE, or "unscaled").

seq_of_zeros

1-D array of roots, or a square matrix (its eigenvalues are used).

unroll

Number of Horner steps unrolled before a loop is used.

a1, a2, u, v, p

Coefficient arrays.

m

Order of the derivative or integral.

k

Integration constants (a scalar or one per integration).

trim_leading_zeros

Whether to remove leading zeros (needs concrete values).

Value

An array; polydiv returns list(quotient, remainder), polyfit with full or cov returns a list.
